question: Who is the author of the book - "The Conscience Network"?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Sugata Srinivasaraju**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The Conscience Network Tells Diaspora's Fight Against Emergency.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
***The Conscience Network*** is a book by **Sugata Srinivasaraju**.

 
 
• 
 
It tells the story of **young Indian diaspora activists in the U.S.**.

 
 
• 
 
These activists **opposed the Emergency (1975–77)** imposed by **Indira Gandhi**.

 
 
• 
 
Their resistance was through **nonviolent and moral protest** from abroad.

 
 
• 
 
The book highlights the **defence of Indian democracy** by those outside the country.

 
 
• 
 
**Sugata Srinivasaraju** is a **veteran journalist**, **columnist**, and **historian** with nearly **30 years of experience**.

 
 
• 
 
He has worked in **senior editorial roles** across **print, TV, and digital media**.

 
 
• 
 
The book adds a **new dimension** to the narrative of **Emergency resistance** by focusing on voices often left out.
